notes.title: v[1.027] Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your feedback and support.
Here are the new features, improvements, and some fixes:

[b][h3]1) Annual Report - Reward [/h3][/b]
Added a new reward for Annual Performance. In the Annual Report, you’ll get uniforms or Kevlar suits depending on your performance. If an extra Vote of Confidence level is achieved, you’ll receive Kevlar suits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/8cfc380ccb398e458dc28d5eeb9b2ea142b0f6a6.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]2) Task Details [/h3][/b]
We’ve added the task details to the “Upcoming Task Widget”. Now you can see the targets and then decide to accept/postpone/decline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/e98a4fbe339f7e4016b2111759930f79124a27e9.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]3) Quarry [/h3][/b]
Quarry roof rotating-mesh location fixed. Quarry mesh had a rotating mesh issue. It’s fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/920a0bd5fc2c31b3f9b33cf99c3fd3fb6c19726b.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]4) Ruin Filter [/h3][/b]
Ruin filter’s outline material is improved. Selected ruins look clear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/7c82045819c9e00e0c272651e7f9c7a9707db0ee.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]5) Improved “Add Road” [/h3][/b]
Improved the Add Road Function. It’s now possible to start “Add Road” from an existing road.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/e6d207574e4cb1c31af4dd7db3a8f007010d6334.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]6) “No Crack” Difficulty Option - Extra Coal[/h3][/b]
"No Crack" option gives extra coal by default.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/44ac278860412cf6068edc22d5f2df31393daaed.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]7) Ambient Lighting - UI[/h3][/b]
Ambient lighting in the main menu, options menu, loading screen, and new profile menu have been increased.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/579e6270c4920dab112f75f556a0624984aec949.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]8) Fixed the “Mouse Lagging” issue [/h3][/b]
We’ve fixed the “Mouse Lagging” issue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/11a0775617220ff24891c6a0339e01e8ef931b52.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]9) New Mouse Cursors [/h3][/b]
We’ve added new mouse cursor types. You can find them in the Options Menu (Gameplay section).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/37d9b620fcbc650e7549d4b527cf13aec6f5b02d.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]10) Mouse Cursor Size [/h3][/b]
New mouse cursor size options can be found in the Options Menu (Gameplay section).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/4d8d4837897bcc68150e2b2d14d72526c8fab68c.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]11) Mouse Settings [/h3][/b]
There is a new setting for the mouse: Invert Mouse Rotation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/e07f8b045758f8534bc35844b76947282b77f9b4.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]12) Camera Settings [/h3][/b]
Here are the new settings for the camera movements:
- Invert Camera Zoom
- Camera Keyboard Sensitivity
- Camera Rotation Sensitivity
- Zoom Sensitivity

These settings can be found in the Options Menu (Gameplay section).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/089e1ff0761f5e9e264206ec5f7442e5daae705e.jpg[/img]


Thanks again for your feedback and suggestions!
We'll continue updating the game towards your feedback.

All the best
TR Games

[b][h3]4) Event Log Notification Sound Mute/Unmute[/h3][/b]
There is a new button on Event Log to mute/unmute the notification sound.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/fd6607e339358ce28b86428b1366a7cf0b6f9f07.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/8fe4d2c5b7f4ab3b73542b977e3fab31e25f36f0.jpg[/img]

[u]Other fixes and improvements:[/u]
*Camera focussing issue fixed by expanding the map limits
*Daily Status - storage demolish issue fixed

Thanks again for your feedback and suggestions!
We'll continue updating the game towards your feedback.

All the best

notes.title: v[1.013] Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your feedback and support.
Here are the new features, improvements, and some fixes:

[b][h3]1) Vote of Confidence Difficulty[/h3][/b]
There is an OFF option for the Vote of Confidence. If you don't want to be evaluated at the end of each year, you should select OFF for Vote of Confidence. As you know, in case of failing the annual target level, your settlers may leave you.
Vote of Confidence shows your leadership performance. When easy is selected, your Vote of Confidence levels up simply. When it's off, there won't be any target level being evaluated at the end of each year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/571bc54d4cbdaff6c811208244d14523f021df65.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]2) Tree Dome Yellow Indicator[/h3][/b]
During building placement, it's possible to see if the building will be under the tree dome.
If the building has a yellow tree image on it, it means that "When the tree dome reaches a certain size, this building will be covered and not consume energy."
(As you know, when a tree reaches 80% vitality, it generates a tree dome. A tree dome reaches its maximum size when its vitality is 100%.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/89c4a653d75da30464fd12a705c28a6d409e9a4f.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]3) Construction Buildings Tree Dome Indicator[/h3][/b]
When you click on a tree, you can see the tree image on top of the construction building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/035ba5876d4cf345a4643e8ea78c1443bbd4ca96.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]4) Tree Placement[/h3][/b]
While planting a tree, you can see if a construction building will be under the dome or not.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/b48f0e07debfd13c946bc1801bd53bc3defde96a.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]5) Storage Single Resource Max Capacity[/h3][/b]
The upper limit of a single resource is increased to the building’s maximum capacity.
Storage (1500) capacity can be used as a maximum for a single resource.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/70b27b50dbceb89bb917f3a9276cee089c8a8327.jpg[/img]

Large Storage (4500) capacity can be used as a maximum for a single resource.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/2be8c1c3554395329e74b2e63b8ee9e1846b5a8c.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]6) Help Menu Extra Info[/h3][/b]
Help-Energy: Coal is stored in the Oxygen Center and used when sustainable energy storage is empty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/6e316186e5dd9326b5cabf3a9ee47bf39543c327.jpg[/img]

Help-Water: Water is also used by Canteen workers to have enough stock, by Signal Tower and Radar teams while going to the target location, by Planthouse workers to produce potatoes and tomatoes, and by tree workers to increase tree vitality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/2f15860f6efaeb7d59c089e7927de38281773e1b.jpg[/img]

Help-Food: Signal Tower and Radar teams consume canned fish while they're going to target locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/a5a902ea21d00430987faa23f8bfefb8c19da89b.jpg[/img]

[u]Other fixes and improvements:[/u]
*Trading Dock waiting materials issue fixed
*Task issue fixed
*Roads on the mountains issue fixed on Sibling Rivers map
*Road construction issue fixed

Thanks again for your feedback and suggestions!
We'll continue updating the game towards your feedback.

All the best
TR Games

notes.title: v[1.004] Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your feedback and support.
Here are the new features, improvements, and some fixes:

[h3]1) Changing a Tree's Location[/h3]
Now it’s possible to change a tree’s location.
If you remove a tree, you'll be able to plant it again, but its vitality will start from 50%.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/bcfeaa4ac8f2bd7b9abab70e649e0cc5c9dcb431.jpg[/img]

[h3]2) Postpone the Tasks[/h3]
Now it’s possible to postpone a task. There is an extra button called “Postpone”.
If you press the “Postpone” button, the task will be postponed, and it will come later. (This is only for main tasks, not for the winds/frosts/droughts tasks)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/3b908bc0a6d5d7a1a64ea0f653a0e03dc5f2177e.jpg[/img]

[h3]3) Demolish Pop up[/h3]
"Are you sure?" pops up when you try to demolish a building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/1b2ac0189686d409b1b68e9fdf90500c246233fd.jpg[/img]

[h3]4) Ruin Filter[/h3]
Ruin Filter doesn't show a ruin when there isn’t any selected material left.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/bba68a38dd056bb36421af657509bd9ccfdc23e6.jpg[/img]

[h3]5) New Shortcut Keys for ”Pause Building” and “Turn ON/OFF Oxygen Generator”[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/e236134ca9f6d3d007f45f65d7816de55c51355f.jpg[/img]

Play/Pause Building - [P] key by default

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/df8ef7cfce521c502962abcd6b6db74b71e58ce5.jpg[/img]

Turn On/Off Oxygen Generator in a building - [O] key by default

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664223/a7082a4d147260031716ece7bf0d13500b459ec7.jpg[/img]

[u]Other fixes and improvements:[/u]
*Gas Extractor Demolish has no effect on Vote of Confidence - Buildings
*Total number of AutoSave files is increased to 10
*Battery and Large Battery energy capacity numbers are fixed for all difficulty levels
*Trading Dock incoming materials issue is fixed
*Research Menu - The line under the “Water Desalinator +2 Water” is removed

Thanks again for your feedback and suggestions!
We'll continue updating the game towards your feedback.

All the best
TR Games

notes.title: v0.99 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your efforts on testing our closed-beta.
Here is the new features, improvements, and some fixes:

*Character Warning widget is implemented. You can see the current status of your settlers if they are sick, homeless, thirsty or hungry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/f7de72d16212d0b38e552ebbbabcf126a816b6de.jpg[/img]

*The map is redesigned. New hills, new river-form, new lake-shapes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/c5871a73e4a5ab09f17445d3d4aa6f0910fbd3c0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/fe97aa44c058507da5ef11e9ef601a4121affbc7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/18e01e00c0ba069755320f1837e976eb9c364def.jpg[/img]

*Map-ground-texture is redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/b0e77e1f27c1f0ba09520e07852b92dd5d98de38.jpg[/img]

*Oxygen Center info-panel is redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/dd1f8608c1a40040f5916cd62c932fb8447aaddd.jpg[/img]

*New difficulty setting is added: Task Difficulty.
This setting affects the task-difficulty in the game. Easy option gives longer task-deadlines, more rewards, and easier tasks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/9a8e06a1b1d3130f56cfeef2c681556c4105e0bf.jpg[/img]

*Crack-explosion-gap is adapted to the "Crack Difficulty" setting.
Cracks release toxic gases and then explode if there is no Gas Extractor placed on them. They can occur anywhere. When easy is selected, its frequency becomes lower and the explosion-gap becomes longer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/0b01702954621d3876ed7a5aefde0d4a4deae519.jpg[/img]

*New tree-sound is added. Notification-volume is adjusted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/f49042b0007df1ad971c3d0db36f66b5f4e7114a.jpg[/img]

*Game-speed [1x] is 2 times faster than before.

As you know, Oxygen: First Breath is a free-beta version of the full-game Oxygen.
In this short-version, you can experience the gameplay, post-apocalyptic theme, and some of the buildings. This version ends when you reach 50 days.
We'll continue updating the game towards your feedback.

notes.title: v0.88 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your efforts on testing our closed-beta.
Here is the new features, improvements, and some fixes:

*Steam Achievements (11) are added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/effe674f0e1c354d3efb7ca3c9fc661316399e8f.png[/img]

*Energy Consumption and Oxygen Sufficiency buttons show the actual energy consumption of the buildings on their tops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/dcf081efe0cfe0037bb9a0222fcdb05d826c55ec.jpg[/img]

*It's possible to prevent any possible crack explosion if you build a Gas Extractor.
Before: When there was a crack with no possibility of Gas Extractor placement, it was forcing you to "dismantle" the building and "rebuild" it.
Now: Gas Extractor is small and you can build it anywhere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/59f1f1e9d22e351ec7eefe3bdfb88180de1f8be3.jpg[/img]

*Decoration Building Information (Star/LightedTree/Fountain/GlobeDecor/ClockTower) is updated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/c8733c6f222ecd65d598245532d93b7dd19bc040.jpg[/img]

*Main/Pause menu "close/back" with ESC-key is functional now. (Right mouse click is still valid for close/back)Tasks are rearranged.
*Task-order, deadlines, rewards are changed.
*Script is updated based on the feedback we've received. Some sentences/words/definitions are changed/corrected and some new explanations are added.

As you know, Oxygen: First Breath is a free-beta version of the full-game Oxygen.
In this short-version, you can experience the gameplay, post-apocalyptic theme, and some of the buildings. This version ends when you reach 50 days.
We'll continue updating the game towards your feedback.
